carousel.description: 5-slide educational carousel — highest save and share rate
carousel.hook_purpose: make a contractor stop scrolling — speak to a pain they feel daily
carousel.notes: slide 1 is the hook — most important. slide 5 is always a soft CTA pointing to the configurator via link in bio.

caption.description: single-image pain-point or results caption — drives profile visits and follows
caption.hook_purpose: open with a line that stops a contractor mid-scroll — make it feel personal
caption.notes: end with — Trevo attribution. short paragraphs, 1-2 sentences max.

trevo_found.description: 'Trevo built this' — shows a new demo or site launch for a real trade/city
trevo_found.hook_purpose: show proof of work — real demo, real trade, real features
trevo_found.notes: ends with 'That's the build. — Trevo'. never names specific clients.

reel.description: 20-second reel script — highest reach, drives new followers
reel.hook_purpose: pattern interrupt — contractor hears this and thinks 'that's me'
reel.notes: hook 2 sec, body 12 sec, cta 6 sec. include b-roll notes inline.
reel.image_type: reel_hook — just the hook line as a quote-style image
